local function buildTemple(city)
 local holy=assert(GameInfo.Districts.DISTRICT_HOLY_SITE).Index
 local temple=assert(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_TEMPLE).Index
 if not city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(temple) then
  local site,empty
  for dir=0,5 do
   local q=Map.GetAdjacentPlot(city:GetX(),city:GetY(),dir)
   if q and q:GetOwner()==city:GetOwner() then
    if q:GetDistrictType()==holy then site=q;break end
    if not empty and q:GetDistrictType()==-1 and q:GetImprovementType()==-1 and not q:IsCity() and not q:IsWater() and not q:IsMountain() and not q:IsImpassable() and not q:IsNaturalWonder() then empty=q end
   end
  end
  if not site then site=assert(empty,'no legal owned Holy Site fixture plot');city:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteDistrict(holy,site:GetIndex(),100) end
  local shrine=assert(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_SHRINE).Index
  if not city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(shrine) then city:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(shrine,site:GetIndex(),100) end
  city:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(temple,site:GetIndex(),100)
 end
 assert(city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(temple),'official temple fixture absent')
 return temple
end

ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeBuildTemple=buildTemple

local t=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE'))
local M={Events=0}
local function location(city,building,slot)
 return {Owner=city:GetOwner(),City=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Building=building,Slot=slot}
end
function M.Locate(index)
 assert(type(index)=='number' and index>=0,'missing native index')
 local found={}
 local owners=PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()
 local free=PlayerManager.GetFreeCitiesPlayerID()
 local hasFree=false;for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do if owner==free then hasFree=true end end
 if free and free>=0 and not hasFree then owners[#owners+1]=free end
 for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do
  for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do
   local buildings=city:GetBuildings()
   for b in GameInfo.Buildings() do
    if buildings:HasBuilding(b.Index) then
     for slot=0,buildings:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(b.Index)-1 do
      if buildings:GetGreatWorkInSlot(b.Index,slot)==index then found[#found+1]=location(city,b.Index,slot) end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return found
end
local function slotValue(loc)
 local city=CityManager.GetCityAt(loc.X,loc.Y)
 assert(city and city:GetOwner()==loc.Owner and city:GetID()==loc.City,'fixture city owner/ID changed')
 return city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(loc.Building,loc.Slot)
end
local function same(a,b)
 return a.Owner==b.Owner and a.City==b.City and a.X==b.X and a.Y==b.Y and a.Building==b.Building and a.Slot==b.Slot
end
function M.Check(label,index,source,dest)
 local locations=M.Locate(index)
 local src=slotValue(source)
 local dst=slotValue(dest)
 print('[JAC_NATIVE_MATRIX_AFTER] case='..label..' index='..index..' source='..tostring(src)..' dest='..tostring(dst)..' count='..#locations..' events='..M.Events)
 assert(#locations==1,'same native index must occupy exactly one physical slot')
 local atSource=same(locations[1],source) and src==index and dst==-1
 local atDest=same(locations[1],dest) and dst==index and src==-1
 assert(atSource or atDest,'native index moved to an unexpected owner/city/building/slot')
 return atDest
end
function M.Expect(label,index,source,dest)
 M.Last={Label=label,Index=index,Source=source,Dest=dest}
end
function M.Verify()
 local r=assert(M.Last)
 return M.Check(r.Label,r.Index,r.Source,r.Dest)
end
function M.Request(label,actor,owner,index,source,dest)
 assert(actor==Game.GetLocalPlayer() and owner==source.Owner and owner==dest.Owner,'positive control requires local actor equal to both physical owners')
 assert(slotValue(source)==index and slotValue(dest)==-1,'move fixture source/destination changed')
 local sb=CityManager.GetCityAt(source.X,source.Y):GetBuildings()
 local db=CityManager.GetCityAt(dest.X,dest.Y):GetBuildings()
 local object=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorks[sb:GetGreatWorkTypeFromIndex(index)]).GreatWorkObjectType
 local srcSlot=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorkSlotTypes[sb:GetGreatWorkSlotType(source.Building,source.Slot)]).GreatWorkSlotType
 local dstSlot=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorkSlotTypes[db:GetGreatWorkSlotType(dest.Building,dest.Slot)]).GreatWorkSlotType
 local valid=false
 for row in GameInfo.GreatWork_ValidSubTypes() do if row.GreatWorkSlotType==dstSlot and row.GreatWorkObjectType==object then valid=true end end
 assert(object=='GREATWORKOBJECT_RELIC' and valid,'official relic fixture incompatible')
 print('[JAC_NATIVE_MATRIX_BEFORE] case='..label..' context=InGame localPlayer='..Game.GetLocalPlayer()..' actor='..actor..' playerOne='..owner..' index='..index..' sourceOwner='..source.Owner..' destOwner='..dest.Owner..' sourceSlot='..srcSlot..' destSlot='..dstSlot)
 local params={}
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_PLAYER_ONE]=owner
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_SRC]=source.City
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_DEST]=dest.City
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_SRC]=source.Building
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_DEST]=dest.Building
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GREAT_WORK_INDEX]=index
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_SLOT]=dest.Slot
 M.Expect(label,index,source,dest)
 local ok,value=pcall(UI.RequestPlayerOperation,actor,PlayerOperations.MOVE_GREAT_WORK,params)
 print('[JAC_NATIVE_MATRIX_DISPATCH] case='..label..' ok='..tostring(ok)..' result='..tostring(value))
 if actor==Game.GetLocalPlayer() then assert(ok,tostring(value)) end
 return ok
end
